title: From BM25 to Corrective RAG: Benchmarking Retrieval Strategies for Text-and-Table Documents
authors: Meftun Akarsu; Recep Kaan Karaman; Christopher Mierbach
why_relevant: Benchmarks retrieval strategies (including CRAG-style corrective retrieval) on financial text-and-table QA, touching on retrieval quality which underlies RAG robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on retrieval method comparison for accuracy, not on noise, conflict, adversarial robustness, or calibration.
